summary: Frontend-only verification of BriefDispatchPanel auto-polling of LearnForge job status (signal 06981200-86b3-412e-9fa6-1578665160f5). All 5 requested scenarios passed via Playwright on the public preview URL: (1) auto-poll fires POST /api/course-jobs/da1c5218-.../refresh automatically within ~6-7s with no manual click, chip shows 'accepted' and job-autosync-indicator is visible; (2) with page.route interception returning status 'ready', chip flipped to READY in ~7s, job-public-url link appeared, READY success toast shown, auto-sync indicator disappeared and NO further /refresh calls were made in the following 9s (polling halted); (3) interception returning 'failed' -> chip shows failed, indicator gone, polling stopped (0 calls in 9s); (4) manual job-refresh-btn click hit the real backend returning HTTP 200 and kept status 'accepted' with no errors; (5) brief-preview-btn rendered brief-preview-json (2404 chars) containing none of modules/lessons/quizzes/syllabus. Zero console errors across all runs; no crashes.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor (non-blocking): the auto-poll useEffect only uses setInterval, so the first status check happens 6s after the panel opens; consider an immediate leading tick so a job already terminal on the server lights up instantly.

Minor: onDispatched is in the poll effect dependency array — if a parent passes a non-memoized callback the interval is torn down/recreated on every parent render, which can delay ticks. Wrap onDispatched in useCallback.
